_readme: Site-wide settings. Edit values here; no design changes needed. Empty strings mean 'not set yet' and the site hides or softens that item automatically.
name: Rollabop
attribution: A game by Lippy Robotics Labs
tagline: The physical pile is the puzzle.
description: Rollabop is a physics puzzle game for Android. Reach into a living pile of balls, rearrange it under gravity, build larger matches, and discover the move that changes everything.
_url_note: Your domain, e.g. https://rollabop.com (no trailing slash). Leave empty until you have one. When set, the site adds canonical links, social preview URLs and a sitemap.

release.label: Coming to Android
release._note: When the Play Store listing is live: paste its URL into playStoreUrl, add the official badge to assets.json (googlePlayBadge), and set status to 'available'. Until then only the 'Coming to Android' label shows.

_version_note: Current game version, e.g. 1.0.0. Leave empty before release; the About page then says 'Not yet released'.
_supportEmail_note: Official support address. Leave empty until you have one; the Support page then says a contact is coming soon.

supportForm._note: The Support page's 'Get Help' form sends messages through Formspree (formspree.io), like the Tolliver site. Create a form in Formspree for Rollabop and paste its ID here (the part after /f/, e.g. 'abcdwxyz'). Leave empty to hide the form; the Support page then shows the email address only. When set, the Privacy page automatically mentions Formspree.

_social_note: Official community links only, e.g. { "label": "YouTube", "url": "https://..." }. Empty list shows nothing.

privacy._note: Keep 'draft' until the policy has had its final review. While it is 'draft' the page shows a review banner and asks search engines not to index it. Set to 'final' and fill lastUpdated (e.g. 2026-11-01) when approved.
